sig
  type nf = { uid : 'a option; desc : nf_desc; approximated : bool; }
  and nf_desc =
      NVar of 'a
    | NApp of nf * nf
    | NAbs of local_env * 'b * 'c * delayed_nf
    | NStruct of 'd
    | NAlias of delayed_nf
    | NProj of nf * 'e
    | NLeaf
    | NComp_unit of string
    | NError of string
  and delayed_nf = Thunk of local_env * 'a
  and local_env = 'a
  val approx_nf : nf -> nf
  val in_memo_table : ('a, 'b) Hashtbl.t -> 'a -> ('c -> 'b) -> 'c -> 'b
  type env = {
    fuel : int ref;
    global_env : 'a;
    local_env : local_env;
    reduce_memo_table : (local_env * 'b, nf) Hashtbl.t;
    read_back_memo_table : (nf, 'c) Hashtbl.t;
  }
  val bind : env -> 'a -> 'b -> env
  val reduce_memo_table : 'a
  val read_back_memo_table : 'a
  val reduce : 'a -> 'b -> 'c
  val is_stuck_on_comp_unit : nf -> bool
  val reduce_aliases_for_uid : 'a -> nf -> result
  val reduce_for_uid : 'a -> 'b -> result
end

           then Format.pp_print_char ppf '\t'

      then raise (Arg.Bad "Ill-formed list of alert settings")
      else
        (match ((s.[i]), (s.[i + 1])) with
         | ('+', '+') -> id (set_alert ~error:true ~enable:true) (i + 2)
         | ('+', _) -> id (set_alert ~error:false ~enable:true) (i + 1)
         | ('-', '-') -> id (set_alert ~error:true ~enable:false) (i + 2)
         | ('-', _) -> id (set_alert ~error:false ~enable:false) (i + 1)
         | ('@', _) ->
             id
               (fun s ->
                  set_alert ~error:true ~enable:true s;
                  set_alert ~error:false ~enable:true s) (i + 1)
         | _ -> raise (Arg.Bad "Ill-formed list of alert settings"))
with
| () -> _)

        fprintf ppf
          (CamlinternalFormatBasics.Format
             ((CamlinternalFormatBasics.Formatting_lit
                 ((CamlinternalFormatBasics.Break ("@ ", 1, 0)),
                   (CamlinternalFormatBasics.Formatting_gen
                      ((CamlinternalFormatBasics.Open_box
                          (CamlinternalFormatBasics.Format
                             ((CamlinternalFormatBasics.String_literal
                                 ("<hov>",
                                   CamlinternalFormatBasics.End_of_format)),
                               "<hov>"))),
                        (CamlinternalFormatBasics.String_literal
                           ("Multiple definitions of module ",

                                (CamlinternalFormatBasics.String_literal
                                   (" in files ",
                                     (CamlinternalFormatBasics.Alpha
                                        (CamlinternalFormatBasics.Formatting_lit
                                           (CamlinternalFormatBasics.Close_box,
                                             CamlinternalFormatBasics.End_of_format)))))))))))),
               "@ @[<hov>Multiple definitions of module %a in files %a@]"))
          Style.inline_code compunit
          (pp_list_comma (Style.as_inline_code print_filename)) files in
      fprintf ppf
        (CamlinternalFormatBasics.Format
           ((CamlinternalFormatBasics.Formatting_gen
               ((CamlinternalFormatBasics.Open_box
                   (CamlinternalFormatBasics.Format
                      ((CamlinternalFormatBasics.String_literal
                          ("<hov 2>", CamlinternalFormatBasics.End_of_format)),
                        "<hov 2>"))),
                 (CamlinternalFormatBasics.String_literal
                    (" Duplicated implementations:",
                      (CamlinternalFormatBasics.Alpha
                         (CamlinternalFormatBasics.Formatting_lit
                            (CamlinternalFormatBasics.Close_box,
                              CamlinternalFormatBasics.End_of_format))))))),
